components.name: audit-integrity

path_rules.name: crate-manifests
path_rules.rationale: Crate manifests affect workspace builds and publication metadata.

quick-fix.recon: Read the changed files and relevant project guidance; use the matching skill when behavior or a focused subsystem is involved.
quick-fix.planning: Use one direct, low-risk task; split work only if its scope grows beyond the explicit low-risk path.
quick-fix.tests: The quick-fix set includes formatting, lint, tests, and the always-on security-regression gate; changed-only selection runs applicable sensors.
quick-fix.evidence: Retain the strict verification result and inspect do-harness status for the quick-fix set.
quick-fix.rationale: Only paths explicitly listed in safe_paths may select quick-fix.

feature.recon: Read the relevant existing path rule, its consumers, and matching focused guidance before changing behavior.
feature.planning: Decompose multi-step work with the repository method catalog and record the task and sensor gate.
feature.tests: Run the changed-only dependent sensors selected by the feature signal set, including the always-on security-regression gate.
feature.evidence: Retain strict sensor results and verify evidence freshness for the feature signal set.
feature.rationale: Only explicitly mapped non-component path rules that are not workspace or security-critical paths may select feature.

security-critical.recon: Read the plugin/API contract, relevant subsystem skill, current invariants, and all affected consumers.
security-critical.planning: Define the contract and failing regression tests first; decompose cross-boundary work and preserve fail-closed behavior.
security-critical.tests: Run the strict, unfiltered full verification signal set and the always-on security-regression gate.
security-critical.evidence: Retain strict full-verification results and confirm evidence freshness for the security-critical signal set.
security-critical.rationale: Default profile for security components, shared APIs, workspace/harness/global changes, and every unsafe, ambiguous, unmapped, or unknown path. Manually escalate whenever classification is uncertain or a change may affect a security boundary.
